name: Warp Prep
acquisition: Starts on every ship
effect_paraphrased: Begin each fight with 1 Shield and 1 Evade
downside: Can be traded away at Boot Sequence or in events (Fake Distress Signal, Worthwhile Trade Repairs)

name: Cargo Hold
acquisition: Artemis start

name: Hunter Wings
acquisition: Artemis only, boss reward
trigger_or_condition: End your turn with unspent Energy
effect_paraphrased: Both wings turn into Empty scaffolding until your next turn, so shots in those lanes pass through
scaling: Value grows with how many lanes enemies aim at your wings
synergy_partners: Standby Mode; Ion Converter (both reward leftover Energy)
downside: Must hold back Energy to get the effect

name: Ares Cannon

name: Control Rods
acquisition: Ares start
